title: 大语言模型推理网络的最优模型激活策略
summary: 本文提出"推理网络"图框架，将不同LLM作为节点、条件激活作为边，研究如何最优组合多个专家模型以平衡成本与性能。针对串联专家模型，证明最优激活策略具有阈值结构：先调用最便宜模型，仅当置信度低于阈值时才调用更贵模型；判别任务每类一个阈值，生成任务单一阈值。实验表明可在满足性能预算下大幅降低成本。
summary_en: This paper introduces inference networks, a graph-based framework where nodes are LLMs and links are conditional activations, to optimally combine expert models balancing cost and performance. For a series of experts, it proves the optimal activation policy has a threshold structure: query the cheapest LLM first and invoke costlier ones only when confidence falls below a threshold—one per class for discriminative tasks, a single threshold for generative tasks. Experiments show substantial cost reductions while meeting performance budgets.
